source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.before: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.after: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves real imprisonment and the pointed chain wordplay.
key_decisions.before: for which I suffer hardship, even to being chained like a criminal. But God’s word is not chained.
key_decisions.after: For it I suffer hardship, even chains like a criminal. But God's word is not chained.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for which I suffer to the point of chains like a criminal. But the word of God is not chained.

key_decisions.before: This saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
key_decisions.after: This saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps promise and warning in matching clauses.
key_decisions.before: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;
key_decisions.after: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he will also deny us;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves divine constancy and its self-related basis without making faithlessness harmless.
key_decisions.before: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, because he cannot deny himself.
key_decisions.after: if we are unfaithful, he remains faithful, for he cannot deny himself.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if we are faithless, he remains faithful—for he cannot deny himself.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains tested laborer and difficult straight-cutting metaphor.
key_decisions.before: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, handling the word of truth straight.
key_decisions.after: Make every effort to present yourself to God as approved, a worker with no cause for shame who cuts the word of truth straight.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves bodily disease image and both names.
key_decisions.before: and their word will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
key_decisions.after: and their talk will spread like gangrene. Hymenaeus and Philetus are among them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and their message will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps target-missing, false timing and real damage.
key_decisions.before: who have departed from the truth, saying the resurrection has already happened, and they are overturning the trust of some.
key_decisions.after: They have missed the mark concerning the truth, saying the resurrection has already happened, and they overturn the faith of some.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who have swerved from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already happened, and they upset the faith of some.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps slave status and three nonviolent teaching qualities.
key_decisions.before: The Lord’s servant must not fight but must be gentle toward everyone, able to teach, patient when wronged,
key_decisions.after: The Lord's slave must not quarrel but must be gentle toward everyone, able to teach and patient when wronged,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome but kind to everyone, able to teach, patient,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps sobriety, trapping and war-captive images.
key_decisions.before: and they may come to their senses and escape the devil’s trap, having been captured by him to do his will.
key_decisions.after: and that they may come to their senses and escape the devil's trap, having been captured alive by him to do his will.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and they may come to their senses and escape from the snare of the devil, having been captured by him to do his will.
